warnings.warning: The 2/3 versus 1/3 tradeoff follows an author-assigned rank rather than biological calibration or stakeholder elicitation.
Each mesh-size interval is replaced by one boundary value, so cost normalization is sensitive to interval representation.
The printed denominator divides the retained-score sum by four, but the reported vector matches division by the undivided sum.
The matrix product is a weighted composition share; no biological calibration supports interpreting it as percent damage.

global_organization_chain: Summary states ranking target, multi-attribute method, leading categories, and policy use
Introduction narrows marine debris to material-specific ingestion risk
Problem analysis connects plastic use, leakage, harm pathways, toxicity, and abundance trend
Terminology fixes risk, abundance, size, attribute, and weight vocabulary
Assumptions expose sampling, mechanism, proxy, and population reductions
Workflow moves from measurement through weighting and decision scoring to policy
Results preserve complete bin scores, retained weights, compositions, and category vector
Strengths and weaknesses separate claimed portability from omitted chemistry, shape, and behavior
Discussion converts category shares into material and product classes
Recommendations expand from class-specific instruments to design, cleanup, monitoring, research, and data infrastructure

main_argument_chains.claim: Two normalized attributes produce a transparent relative ranking of mesh-size bins.
support_steps: Assign reciprocal-rank weights to abundance and size.
Normalize abundance as a benefit and size as a cost.
Report the complete six-bin weighted score vector.
main_argument_chains.decision_consequence: Use the scores as a reconstructable heuristic ranking, conditional on the chosen attributes and weights.

main_argument_chains.claim: Retained-bin compositions can be aggregated into a labeled material score vector.
support_steps: State the retained set and four score shares.
Normalize each retained bin across six plastic categories.
Multiply retained weights by the composition matrix.
Report every category value and distinguish score shares from harm outcomes.
main_argument_chains.decision_consequence: Rank materials only as model score shares until biological validation is supplied.

main_argument_chains.claim: Policy translation requires an explicit bridge beyond the material ranking.
support_steps: Group material scores into high, middle, and low classes.
Align tax, reuse, fine, and funding instruments by class.
Add cleanup, monitoring, research, and database actions with separate evidence needs.
main_argument_chains.decision_consequence: Treat policy numbers as proposals requiring effectiveness, cost, legal, equity, and ecological analysis.

visualization_dispositions.analytical_purpose: A simple line chart communicates an increasing abundance series, but no sampling uncertainty, comparability note, or complete unit treatment is visible.
The workflow diagram makes the analysis sequence scannable, although feedback arrows and the simulation label imply dynamics that are not mathematically modeled.
Compact tables expose the raw bin totals and decision matrix needed to audit normalization.
Side-by-side raw and normalized composition tables make the row-normalization step reconstructable.
A 3D categorical bar chart adds perspective distortion and omits uncertainty; a sorted 2D dot or bar plot with intervals would communicate the same one-dimensional result more honestly.
